description: This file defines the VerticalLabelUI class, a custom Swing UI component for rendering vertical labels with optional clockwise rotation in a Java GUI application.

classes.name: VerticalLabelUI
classes.description: A custom UI delegate for JLabel that displays the label's text and icon vertically, supporting clockwise or counter-clockwise rotation.

methods.name: VerticalLabelUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI with the specified rotation direction.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Overrides to swap width and height to account for vertical orientation.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Handles painting the label's icon and text vertically with appropriate transformations.
